Healthy skin care routine ke liye, aapko kuch basic steps follow karne chahiye:

1. **Cleansing**: Apne chehre ko din mein do baar ek gentle cleanser se saaf karein. Yeh aapki skin se dirt aur excess oil ko hata dega.

2. **Moisturizing**: Apne skin type ke hisaab se ek achha moisturizer lagana zaroori hai. Yeh aapki skin ko hydration dega aur dryness se bachayega.

What is my skin type

You can determine your skin type by doing a simple test at home. Wash your face with a gentle cleanser and leave it bare for about 30 minutes. 

- If your skin feels oily or looks shiny, you may have oily skin.
- If it feels tight or dry, you may have dry skin.
- If some areas are oily (usually the T-zone) and others are dry, you may have combination skin.
- If your skin feels comfortable without excess oil or dryness, it is likely normal.

How to know the skin type

You can determine your skin type by performing a simple test at home. Start by washing your face with a gentle cleanser and leave it bare for about 30 minutes. 

- If your skin feels oily or looks shiny, you may have oily skin.
- If it feels tight or dry, you may have dry skin.
- If some areas are oily (usually the T-zone) and others are dry, you may have combination skin.
- If your skin feels comfortable without excess oil or dryness, it is likely normal.

What is my skin type?

You can determine your skin type by doing a simple test at home. Wash your face with a gentle cleanser and leave it bare for about 30 minutes. 

- If your skin feels oily or looks shiny, you may have oily skin.
- If it feels tight or dry, you may have dry skin.
- If some areas are oily (usually the T-zone) and others are dry, you may have combination skin.
- If your skin feels comfortable without excess oil or dryness, it is likely normal.

You can determine your skin type by doing a simple test at home. Wash your face with a gentle cleanser and leave it bare for about 30 minutes. 

- If your skin feels oily or looks shiny, you may have oily skin.
- If it feels tight or dry, you may have dry skin.
- If some areas are oily (usually the T-zone) and others are dry, you may have combination skin.
- If your skin feels comfortable without excess oil or dryness, it is likely normal.
